raw: 44.1 Personal Knowledge Management (PKM) Systems for Intelligence Professionals
teaching_note: PKM organizes captured information for later retrieval and use; information architecture specifies identities, relationships, versions, permissions, and lifecycle rules that keep that use inspectable. An original source is evidence, a source note records a passage and locator, a claim ledger records an assessment, and a brief communicates selected judgments; one is not a substitute for another. The inherited influence-policy citations supply context, not validation of a named PKM method or cognitive-performance benefit [@ageint266; @ageint269].
title: Personal Knowledge Management (PKM) Systems for Intelligence Professionals

raw: 44.1.1 Zettelkasten: German Note-Taking System for Researchers
teaching_note: For this classroom method, an atomic note contains one bounded idea with a stable identifier and explicit links to evidence, objections, and related ideas; atomic does not mean stripping away qualifiers. A quotation stays distinct from the analyst's paraphrase and inference, and a link means a declared relationship rather than corroboration by default. This is a proposed linked-note practice, not a historical or efficacy claim established by the inherited software/ICS citations; provenance standards support traceability requirements, not validation of Zettelkasten as a productivity intervention [@ageint266; @ageint269].
title: Zettelkasten: Linked Atomic Notes and Evidence Boundaries

raw: 44.1.2 Obsidian, Roam Research, LogSeq: PKM Tools for Analysts
teaching_note: Treat these names as candidate tools, not endorsements or verified security equivalence. A version-specific evaluation asks where storage/sync occurs, what plugins can access, how sharing permissions work, whether exports preserve identifiers/links/caveats, and whether a backup can actually restore them; unknown answers remain unknown until checked against current direct documentation and a controlled test. No product capabilities or secure configuration are inferred from unrelated bibliography entries, and no live installation, plugin, or network change is required here [@ageint269].
title: Obsidian, Roam Research, LogSeq: Tool-Evaluation Questions

raw: 44.1.3 Second Brain Methodology Applied to Intelligence Collection
teaching_note: Second Brain is a metaphor for an external information system, not a neural mechanism or replacement for judgment. A saved summary may assist re-entry, but it cannot replace the original source or establish retained understanding; a short later retrieval/explanation task addresses a different question from storage success. Capture only allowed synthetic material here, preserve the source pointer and uncertainty, and do not treat this workflow as evidence of improved memory or intelligence accuracy.
title: Second Brain as External Notes: Capture Is Not Understanding

teaching_note: **Completed synthetic note-to-correction case.** Supplied original A v1 at 09:00, paragraph 2, says 'North wing closes at 14:00'; summary B at 09:10 omits North wing, while independent schedule C says South wing stays open until 16:00. Atomic note N1 v1 records claim North closes 14:00; quote=A paragraph 2; paraphrase=North-only closure; origin/dependency=A; inference=none about whole-site closure; assumption=A remains current; contradiction link=B's broader reading; handling=synthetic classroom; retention=end-of-course review; downstream=P1 visit brief, P2 comparison worksheet. B is grouped under A rather than counted as corroboration, and the whole-site claim is held. At 10:00 supplied correction A v2 changes North to 15:00: N1 v2 supersedes v1, P1 and P2 are marked stale and corrected, while C's South-at-16:00 claim stays unchanged. The bounded result is two wing-specific times with versioned support, not a new whole-site inference; missing a source locator or correction relation stops release [@ageint266; @ageint269; @sec:analytic-workflow].
title: Information Diet and Source Hygiene

raw: 44.3 Distraction Architecture: Designing Environments for Deep Analytical Work
teaching_note: In the synthetic case, a saved query 'North wing + current version + source A' retrieves N1 v2; an unfiltered search may still rank stale N1 v1 or copied B first. Search rank is not truth, completeness, or version authority, so a re-entry note records the current source and pending contradiction rather than merely the last open tab. Optional notification batching must preserve urgent correction/accessibility channels; STIX/TAXII do not demonstrate attention or deep-work benefits.
title: Distraction Architecture: Retrieval, Re-Entry, and Necessary Interruptions

raw: 44.4 Collaborative Intelligence: Team Workflows, Shared Notes, Secure Platforms
teaching_note: A source of truth is the declared authoritative record for a specified field and version, not the most convenient shared copy or a claim that the record cannot be wrong. In the fictional case A controls the North closure field, C controls the separately supplied South schedule field, and the claim ledger controls review status; an AI summary controls none of them. On paper, export N1 with its stable ID, source/version, quotation boundary, contradictory link, and P1/P2 dependencies; a supplied export missing version metadata fails acceptance even if its prose looks identical. Sharing, synchronization, and backup are distinct functions, and no platform is deemed secure from its label alone [@ageint266; @ageint268; @ageint269].
title: Collaborative Intelligence: Shared Notes, Source of Truth, and Correction Propagation

raw: 44.5 The Analyst's Toolkit: Hardware, Software, and Network Configuration
teaching_note: Choose a toolkit against the allowed information and retrieval task, not an assumed productivity or security ranking. A retained snapshot documents what was available at a time, not current truth; a search index may omit inaccessible, deleted, unindexed, or image-only records, so no hit does not prove no source exists. Keep correction/supersession status visible in the archive, declare retention and access limits, and require portable provenance and an authorized restoration check before relying on backups. If rights, plugin access, sync destination, or retention authority is unclear, stop ingest or sharing rather than inventing a safe configuration [@ageint268; @ageint269].
title: The Analyst's Toolkit: Governed Storage, Retrieval, and Lifecycle Limits
